record.body:
## Description

A waiting row's title ends with a muted 'waits on a, b'; a running row's status reads 'running 14m' (relative_time style); the task detail chips show the running time. Drop the phase column from the phase-grouped task table at every width; keep it in --once. Waits on task-row-model.

payload.title: Show waits-on and running time and drop the phase column

record.subject: task-row-cells
